title: NewtonX Powers Salesforce CIO Study 2026: AI Adoption Jumps 282% as 42% of Enterprises Reach Full Implementation
summary: NewtonX conducted Salesforce's 2026 CIO Study, surveying 200 CIOs across 24 countries. The study reveals a 282% jump in full AI implementation (from 11% in 2024 to 42% in 2025), with CIOs now allocating approximately 30% of their AI budgets to agentic AI solutions.
